authority: User-supplied documents; source-specific variants retained. Runtime is a separate read-only code snapshot.

schema_notes.null: Not supplied or not confirmed; never invent to fill null.
schema_notes.source_based_selection: Display choice among attested variants, not a silent source correction.
schema_notes.phrase_id: Stable SHA-256 prefix of punctuation/whitespace-normalized source text; source occurrences keep original witness and tokens.
schema_notes.page_numbering: PDF 1-based. Printed page is optional and distinct.
schema_notes.word_phrase_links: Editorial lexical tokens; character containment stored separately.
schema_notes.exercise_keys: No original audio answers manufactured. Visual inventory, printed passage and open-response are distinct task types; populated records do not certify full-page literal transcription.
schema_notes.native_transcripts: Read as extraction cache; hidden text and layout can remain. Not validated dictionary data.
schema_notes.runtime: Registration or eligibility only; not actual play success, deployed URL or available audio.

storage.format: Checksummed XZ/base64 source records; standard-library Python reader
